pages.title: Lava in a Cup
pages.text: For fire dragons: this warm drink boosts direct human-form combat breath damage.

pages.title: Crafting the Drink
pages.text: Place one lava bucket, magma cream, and blaze rod in the same crafting-table column, in any vertical order.

pages.title: A Fire Dragon Accessory
pages.text: Only a fire dragon can wear this drink as an accessory. However long the road, it stays warm.
